component.name: Virtual Machines
component.summary: Protected virtual machines on the Gunyah hypervisor

description.p: Create, run and manage virtual machines on Snapdragon devices whose hypervisor is Qualcomm Gunyah (no KVM), with crosvm protected VMs: a catalogue of verified guest images, ISO installs through UEFI, disks, shared folders, NAT networking with port forwards, a serial console and offline snapshots.
